corrections.finding: Raw submission totals, unique prompts and selected tool-calling pools are distinct. Threshold 0.99 applies to Prompt Shield/TaskTracker, not automatically the LLM Judge. Submitted raw record is not independently reverified.
The 77.3% o3 task result and 0/949 Claude attack result are different slices. Same-Claude tool-filter/CaMeL clean utility is 73.20%/63.92%; under attack 72.71%/66.70%.

Pinned notebook overwrites security with zero for execution errors. A static attack-count interval formula mixes a proportion and count; execution and paper-generation lineage remain unverified. Do not treat its reported error bars as independently validated.

Safety uses whole simulated 5000-problem deployments from 1500 generated problems; usefulness uses benign GPT-4 and model-relative normalization. Audit labor is simulated with strong detection assumptions. Empty protocols feed is not populated outcomes.
2025 refusal increment, 2026 shadow flag rate, 3.5%-of-old-classifier cost, and roughly 1%-of-Opus 4.0-traffic cost have different denominators. Do not compute a like-for-like longitudinal gain.
373 retained participants supplied 2842 decisions; preserve 690 advice-viewing subtotal versus 698 retained on-demand decisions. Null interactions are imprecise, not equivalence.
Only the carb-source endpoint shows the quoted significant overreliance change. Pooled trust/preference differences were nonsignificant; preserve SE rather than invent CI or event numerators.
Model B effort is strictly greater than 420 minutes. GPT-5.5 final mitigation effectiveness remains unverified; revisions do not create a success outcome.
